description: How many investors backed public fintech equity rounds in the last 12 months that match a country / stage / sub-sector, the top 3 investors by matching rounds (with whether they have a fund on Deploying now), and a coverage caveat (share of rounds in the period with a known country). Optional filters apply to the qualifying rounds: topic (topic slug, via the news linked to the round), country (company's country slug), stage (pre-seed, seed, series-a, series-b, series-c-plus, growth — derived from round_type). All arguments optional. Unknown arguments are rejected.
name: coverage_check
title: Coverage check: investors behind matching fintech rounds
